measure: reported hate crime incidents by bias motivation
notes: The 2000-2011 incident counts were transcribed from the ADL's compilation of FBI annual data, except the 2000 anti-black row, which was corrected to 2,904 from the archived official FBI Section II table after the ADL value of 3,884 produced a false visual spike. Official FBI annual reports/workbooks were used at the endpoints and for 1996-1999. Terminology changed across releases; labels are harmonized to the book's five visible series.
